title: Kissed Syrian Lettuce Flatbread
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring iceberg lettuce and long-fermentation-dough, perfect for a festive and low-calorie-friendly meal. The combination of sour and flaky flavors creates a unique taste experience.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Gradually add warm water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it ferment for 2 hours.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the dough into a thin circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spread the chopped lettuce over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Drizzle olive oil, sumac, and lemon juice over the lettuce.
Fold the edges of the dough over the filling to form a crust.
Bake the flatbread for 20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
